notes.title: Version 0.14
notes.content:
After a few days of being up on Early Access, some bugs and rough spots that slipped through have been addressed. 

Version 0.14 - Release Notes:

- Save/Continue functionality added 
- 3D Menu positions adjusted
- Application button functions on VIVE controls flipped L/R
   [left app button toggles in-air inventory, while right app button opens the in-game menu]
- Enabled floor arrow traps 
- Adjusted armory and maze layout sizes 
- Added splash screen and displayed version number
- Minor bugfixes and tweaks throughout
